projects.projectName: Premera Blue Cross - Producer Portal Development - Phase 1

riskDescription.context: ALT (23-Oct-2026) reports that Premera plans a big-bang rollout to 2,500+ producers on October 22, with only 11 users tested end-to-end successfully. The project is on WATCHLIST status, and ALT identifies a rollback risk if issues are encountered during mass onboarding.
riskDescription.condition: If technical or process issues surface during the mass producer onboarding, the rollout may need to be rolled back and remediated, delaying producer access to the portal.
riskDescription.consequence: A rollback would disrupt onboarding for 2,500+ producers, damage client confidence in the platform's stability, require emergency remediation effort, and potentially delay go-live timelines.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Implement phased producer onboarding with cohort validation gates and automated health checks before each wave.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon detection of critical onboarding failure, activate rollback procedure within 2 hours and escalate to executive steering committee.
risks.reasoning: ALT escalation trigger is active with big-bang approach to 2,500+ users after limited 11-user pilot. Project is on WATCHLIST. EMS go-green plan shows ongoing stabilization activities (retry logic, alert re-enablement). Target Date: 2026-12-31.

riskDescription.context: EMS go-green plan states 'Citrix - Slowness and frequent disconnection having an impact in delivery - Ticket to be raised with Premera to address the same.' This infrastructure issue is currently affecting the delivery team.
riskDescription.condition: If Citrix performance issues persist without resolution, team productivity may continue to degrade, slowing development, testing, and support activities during the critical post-deployment phase.
riskDescription.consequence: Sustained delivery slowdown could delay defect remediation, hypercare response times, and any remaining scope work, impacting client satisfaction and operational efficiency.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Escalate Citrix performance issue to Premera infrastructure team with SLA-tracked ticket and daily status reviews.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If Citrix issues persist beyond 48 hours, reprioritize team to offline tasks and notify client of delivery impact.
risks.reasoning: Open item in EMS go-green plan with confirmed delivery impact. Ticket to Premera not yet raised (EMS). Single-source signal. Target Date: 2026-12-31.

riskDescription.context: EMS Risk R857 (Identified, Moderate severity, Likely likelihood, Medium impact, opened 2026-06-29) reports that the project has absorbed approximately 14 scope changes equivalent to 0.75–1 sprint of additional effort. Mitigation status is Assessed, but mitigation plan 'needs to be arrived.'
riskDescription.condition: If the client requests further scope additions without timeline or budget adjustments, the remaining delivery window to 2026-12-31 may become insufficient to complete all committed work.
riskDescription.consequence: Timeline pressure could force scope descoping, quality compromises, or require a project extension, eroding margin and client trust.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Establish formal change request process with impact assessment and client approval before accepting any new scope.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: When scope additions exceed 1 sprint equivalent, rebaseline delivery plan with client prioritization and phased go-live approach.
risks.reasoning: Open EMS risk (R857) with no finalized mitigation plan. 14 scope changes already absorbed. Project end date is 2026-12-31. Likelihood depends on client future behavior. Target Date: 2026-12-31.
